title: 6529 Works convention documents: shared definitions
description: Definitions the other convention schemas reference. Hex values are lowercase so that two documents naming the same value compare equal as text. See docs/spec/declarations-and-conventions.md.

uint256.description: An unsigned 256-bit integer as a decimal string, so no JSON parser rounds it.

unixTime.description: Unix time in seconds (a uint64 in typed data; kept within JSON's exact integers).

hashRef.description: A hash with its algorithm, numbered as the statement log numbers them: 1 keccak256, 2 SHA-256, 3 BLAKE3.

workRef.description: A token on any EVM chain: chain ID, token contract and token ID.

contentAddress.description: A content address in the one spelling WorkRecords accepts as a locator (WS-18): ar:// and a 43-character base64url transaction ID, or ipfs:// and a 59-character base32 CIDv1 starting bafkrei or bafybei, each with zero padding bits. WorkRecords' check is the authority; this pattern is the same shape.

citationRelation.description: How a citing work relates to the work it cites.

powerName.description: The name of a work power as the IWorkPowers view added by ADR 0006 names it.

signature.description: A signature as hex: 65 bytes, 64 bytes (ERC-2098), or a longer ERC-1271 signature of at most 4,096 bytes.
